items.title: Sira,an AI native flight booking experience
items.raw_excerpt: Sira is a chat-first flight booking interface built on top of published airline fares. You describe the trip in plain English, and Sira returns normalized options instantly. The price shown is the final price — no added service fees or checkout upsells. We surface published fares directly rather than consolidator inventory, and we keep the flow intentionally minimal. The goal is to reduce friction between intent and booking. Under the hood, we reconcile availability and pricing from standard distribution channels and present a simplified booking layer on top. Would love feedback from anyone who has worked with airline distribution or built in travel.

items.title: 豆包除夕AI互动19亿次 Seedance2.0为春晚提供技术支持
items.raw_excerpt: 2月16日，字节跳动旗下AI助手豆包与央视总台春晚联动，面向全国观众送出10万份科技好礼，并推出多项AI互动玩法。豆包方面披露，除夕当天豆包AI互动总数达19亿。春节场景下的AI图片生成、拜年祝福等玩法吸引用户参与。数据显示，“豆包过年”活动在除夕帮助用户生成超过5000万张新春主题头像、生成超过1亿条新春祝福。 今年是总台春晚历史上第一次用 AI 驱动全民实时创作互动。据字节跳动统计，除夕当天，豆包大模型的峰值TPM（每分钟token数）出现在21时46分，正是在春晚主持人宣布用豆包进行第二轮互动之后。这一分钟内，豆包大模型的推理吞吐量达到633亿tokens。字节跳动旗下火山引擎通过算力灵活调配和系统深度优化，全程保障了豆包 AI 互动的稳定流畅。 作为总台春晚独家 AI 云合作伙伴，火山引擎为春晚提供先进的多模态大模型和云计算技术支撑。最近火遍全球的豆包视频生成模型Seedance 2.0，在发布前就已用于多个春晚节目的视觉创作中。 据火山引擎介绍，《驭风歌》节目希望动态演绎国宝级水墨画，Seedance 2.0不仅精准保留了水墨画的笔触、墨韵，还完成了一系列高难度的运动与镜头调度，保证马匹奔跑动作生动自然的同时，也维持了原作的力量感与节奏感。在《贺花神》节目中，该模型又展现了极致的细节把控能力。在蜀葵花和金鱼的制作中，Seedance 2.0为每位演员定制了“一月一人一景，一花一态一观”的视觉奇观，以“AI 生成影像+实景舞台扩展”的模式，构建出一种全新的舞台视听叙事结构。 目前，Seedance 2.0和最新的豆包大模型 2.0 Pro均已上线豆包App、电脑客户端及网页版。用户可以通过“专家模式”和“Seedance 2.0”入口体验。 此外，火山引擎还通过多项 AI 技术为春晚舞台和抖音直播体验赋能。通过空间视频技术，《梦底》打造了演员 3D 数字分身同台表演

excerpt_i18n.en: On February 16, ByteDance's AI assistant Doubao collaborated with China Media Group's Spring Festival Gala, offering 100,000 tech gifts to viewers nationwide and introducing various AI interactive features. Doubao disclosed that on New Year's Eve, the total number of AI interactions reached 1.9 billion. AI-powered activities such as image generation and New Year greetings attracted widespread user participation. Data shows that the "Doubao Celebrates the New Year" campaign helped users generate over 50 million festive-themed profile pictures and more than 100 million New Year greetings. This year marked the first time in the history of the Spring Festival Gala that AI was used to drive real-time interactive creation nationwide. According to ByteDance statistics, the peak TPM (tokens per minute) for Doubao's large model occurred at 21:46 on New Year's Eve, immediately after the gala hosts announced the second round of interactions using Doubao. During that minute, the model's inference throughput reached 63.3 billion tokens. ByteDance's Volcano Engine ensured the stability and smoothness of Doubao's AI interactions throughout the event through flexible computing resource allocation and deep system optimization. As the exclusive AI cloud partner for the Spring Festival Gala, Volcano Engine provided advanced multimodal large models and cloud computing support. Doubao's video generation model Seedance 2.0, which recently gained global popularity, was used in the visual creation of several gala programs even before its official release. According to Volcano Engine, for the program "Song of Riding the Wind," which aimed to dynamically interpret national treasure-level ink paintings, Seedance 2.0 not only accurately preserved the brushstrokes and ink charm of the paintings but also executed a series of complex movements and camera adjustments.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 16 de febrero, Doubao, el asistente de IA de ByteDance, colaboró con la Gala de la CCTV para ofrecer 100,000 regalos tecnológicos a los espectadores de todo el país e introducir varias funciones interactivas de IA. Doubao reveló que el día de la Nochevieja, las interacciones totales con la IA alcanzaron los 1.9 mil millones. Actividades como la generación de imágenes de IA y los mensajes de felicitación del Año Nuevo atrajeron la participación de los usuarios. Los datos muestran que la campaña "Doubao en el Año Nuevo" ayudó a los usuarios a generar más de 50 millones de avatares con temática festiva y más de 100 millones de mensajes de felicitación. Este año marcó la primera vez en la historia de la Gala de la CCTV que se utilizó la IA para impulsar la creación e interacción en tiempo real a nivel nacional. Según las estadísticas de ByteDance, el día de la Nochevieja, el pico de TPM (tokens por minuto) del modelo de lenguaje grande de Doubao

items.title: Ferret-UI Lite: Lessons from Building Small On-Device GUI Agents
items.raw_excerpt: Developing autonomous agents that effectively interact with Graphic User Interfaces (GUIs) remains a challenging open problem, especially for small on-device models. In this paper, we present Ferret-UI Lite, a compact, end-to-end GUI agent that operates across diverse platforms, including mobile, web, and desktop.
